decks.summary: Vamp-and-Snitch Winifred who commits two cards to every test to draw and recover them, parleys with Vamp and Snitch, and takes clues with Lockpicks on Pickpocketing money.
Action-machine Winifred for Hard who chains Swift Reflexes, Leo De Luca and Honed Instinct, investigates with Thieves' Kits, and shops the Underworld Market for Pilfer and Easy Mark.
Full-power clue-beast Winifred with two Chuck Fergus, Lockpicks and Pilfer (3) for big clue turns, and Ace in the Hole and Quick Thinking for extra actions.
Level 0 Winifred with .25 Automatics and Lockpicks, Lonnie Ritter and Leather Jacket to cover her willpower, and skills like Daredevil and Hatchet Man to commit and recover.
Old Shotgun Winifred who oversucceeds with Lucky Cigarette Case (3) and Quick Thinking and shoots through Dirty Fighting, with Pickpocketing and Streetwise for economy.
Solo billionaire Winifred who depletes her deck fast with Underworld Support, piles up money with Unscrupulous Loan, and spends it on The Black Fan, The Red Clock and Chuck Fergus.
Fantasy Flight's official Winifred starter deck: Lockpicks, Mauser C96 and Switchblade, and Cheap Shot, Pilfer and Slip Away rewarding the big successes her overcommitting produces.
Simple Forgotten Age Winifred who handles monsters by evading and hitting with Cheap Shot, Backstab and Mauser C96, feeding extra cards into tests through Crystallizer of Dreams.
Revised Core and starter-pack Winifred who reaches an effective 7 agility with Cat Burglars and Charisma, investigating with Lockpicks and Pilfer and striking with Backstab.
A skill-heavy remix of Harder. Better. Faster. Stronger.: .25 Automatics, Lockpicks and Lonnie Ritter, with plenty of skills to commit and recover.
